units.title: Theory of Drying
topics: 1.1. Introduction to drying and factors governing the drying.
1.2. Drying systems and details of various stages of drying
1.3. Drying shrinkage, Drying efficiency and Rate of drying.
1.4. Process of drying such as evaporation, aeration, heating ventilations and absorption.
uos: 1.c. Describe Drying shrinkage, Drying efficiency, Rate of Drying

units.title: Classification of Dryers
topics: 2.3. Construction and functions of tunnel dryers. Mangle dryers, rotary dryers ,spray Dryers, infrared drying, high frequency drying ,Humidity dryer, Horizontal dryer and Vertical dryer
2.4. Defects during drying and their rectification.
uos: 2.c. Describe the working of various types of dryers listed in 2.3.
2.e. List the steps to Rectify the defects due to drying.

units.title: Effect of Heat on Ceramic Wares

4.3. Defects occurs in bodies and glazes after firing.
